title: A lane session always runs the worker hooks, whatever its slug
body:
Why: logic audit: src/cli/lane-run.ts:90 sets KRN_SESSION_CLASS=lane but not KRN_TASK; scripts/claude/worker-scope.ts:80-86 derives the task only from a t-id in branch or path, so a lane with --slug lacking the id runs as a lead and worker-stop and worker-scope allow everything.
Outcome: lane run exports KRN_TASK; a lane-class session with no task id is refused at the first hook, never treated as lead.
Proof: test: lane run with slug 'fix-x' blocks Stop without a commit.
Scope: src/cli/, scripts/claude/, test/.
